context:
Look-before-you-leap: read the test first, decide port vs keep based on
what lxml feature it actually uses. Don't blindly remove and break.
description:
`lxml>=5.0.0` is declared in `[dependency-groups] dev`. The only import
site in the entire repo is `tests/unit/core/tpcdi/test_etl_sources.py:22`.
TPC-DI ETL itself uses stdlib `xml.etree`, not lxml.

Two options:
  A. Port the single test to `xml.etree.ElementTree` and remove the dep.
  B. Keep the dep and add an inline comment in pyproject.toml explaining
     why this single test needs lxml-specific behavior.

Option A is preferred unless the test relies on lxml-specific XPath /
validation features that stdlib cannot replicate.

Source for this finding: `docs/development/dependency-inventory.md` (F3),
produced by `audit-imported-dependencies-for-elimination`.

anti_patterns.dont: remove lxml without porting the test

deferrals.reason: Out of scope; covered by the parent audit.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] obsolete: Explicitly marked out of scope and covered by the parent dependency audit, which is done.
deferrals.summary: Audit other dev deps with single-test usage

preserves.behavior: `benchbox/core/tpcdi/etl/` continues to use stdlib xml.etree (no lxml import added)

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "import tomllib, pathlib; d = tomllib.loads(pathlib.Path('pyproject.toml').read_text()); all_specs = d['project']['dependencies'] + sum(d['project'].get('optional-dependencies', {}).values(), []) + sum((g for g in d.get('dependency-groups', {}).values()), []); has_lxml = any(isinstance(s, str) and 'lxml' in s for s in all_specs); print('LXML_PRESENT' if has_lxml else 'OK: lxml fully removed')"
verifications.description: If removal path was taken, lxml not declared anywhere
verifications.expected: OK: lxml fully removed (or LXML_PRESENT if keep-with-rationale was chosen)

work_units.summary: Read `tests/unit/core/tpcdi/test_etl_sources.py` and identify which lxml API surface (XPath / validation / parser) the test actually uses.
Decide port-vs-keep based on w1 findings: stdlib-only API → port to xml.etree; lxml-specific features → keep dep with inline rationale.
If ported: remove `lxml>=5.0.0` from `[dependency-groups] dev` and refresh uv.lock.
Run the affected test to confirm it still passes: `uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/core/tpcdi/test_etl_sources.py -v`.
